reviewer.method: Personally read all202 blocks of public publisher preview, all5 public main figure images, all30 pages of Supplement1 including every raw blot, all7 pages of Supplement2 in text and pixels, and all36 displayed paragraphs plus both rendered pages of Supplement3. patient_identity.statement: Packet subject says Family5 Proband II-1. Figure1B labels the affected female variant carrier II-2; II-1 is the male partner. Family number and variant strongly identify the intended woman, but the individual ordinal is wrong and is not silently corrected.

genotype.statement: For intended affected female II-2,Figure1B/C supports heterozygous c.2323C>T (p.Pro775Ser) matching the packet coding/protein label. Figure1C uses NM_001127255.1, whereas packet uses.2. Packet hg38 coordinate and transcript-version equivalence were not independently verified.

evidence.locator: PanelB Family5 pedigree and Sanger;panelC transcript/protein diagram

limitations: Genotype evidence applies to the intended female II-2, not the literal packet II-1. Reference mapping remains unverified.

segregation.statement: Figure1B Family5 marks both parents and partner with question marks; only affected woman is molecularly displayed. Supplement3 selection criterion permits de novo or paternal variants, but does not establish inheritance in this individual.
limitations: Do not convert a filter rule into measured segregation. Main family narrative unavailable.

phase.statement: One heterozygous variant is displayed for the intended affected woman. No pair of variants requires cis/trans resolution; absence of other contributors cannot be established from the preview.

evidence.locator: PanelB Family5 pedigree and Sanger;panelC transcript/protein diagram

limitations: Main sequencing/case narrative unavailable; this is not proof that all alternative alleles were excluded.

causal_confidence.statement: Abstract attributes early embryo arrest to five NLRP7 variants. Figure3 shows association of expressed proteins with SCMC components; Figures4/5 show model oocyte/embryo phenotypes. These observations support a proposed mechanism but do not independently establish this packet as solved/pathogenic. Main methods, clinical narrative and discussion are unavailable. Variant selection already required de novo/paternal inheritance and fertile female noncarriers, so that pattern cannot be treated as an independent unselected test.
limitations: Public abstract and model figures do not replace complete clinical/source review. No independent ACMG classification or patient functional validation performed.

phenotype_completeness.statement: TableS4 adds infertility duration10years and basal hormones plus BMI and AMH. These are omitted from the packet. Main clinical narratives and any main tables remain unread, preventing a complete phenotype audit.
limitations: Dash means unreported, not normal/negative. Clinical hormone values are not independently interpreted or converted into new diagnoses.

limitations: Paper remains incomplete despite full reading of the3public supplements and5main figure images. Full main text, main figure legends and main table inventory unresolved.

Figure1B labels all5affected femalesII-2,including all3assigned cases. Family1and2show carrier fathers; families3-5parental genotypes are question marks. Do not extrapolate paternal transmission to those families.
Supplement3 MAF<1% is an ascertainment threshold, not evidence of population absence. Historical filters were not re-run; no current database-frequency claim.

Supplement1 S1/S3 raw-blot replicates use ACTIN for the first replicate and GAPDH for later replicates. Several raw panels explicitly mark crops/separate exposures. These were read, not quantitatively reanalysed; no claim of an experimental defect solely from those labels.
Figure3 raw data include a first NLRP5/TLE6 experiment with variant series but later partner-association replicates use WT+/-partner. Do not claim3complete independent variant-association series.

Mouse-model and overexpression observations do not directly verify human pathogenicity, penetrance, recurrence risk, or efficacy. No experimental design/execution or clinical recommendation is produced.

Inherited acquisitions credited as such; this continuation personally read the enumerated material. Historical public-control HG002/FGFR2 rank exposed by mandatoryHANDOFF; no target outcomes consulted; not blinded.
